camel_example: aliyun ehpc ModifyUserGroups --region cn-hangzhou --User.1.Group users --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --User.1.Name user11
description_en: Changes the user group to which users belong
description_zh: 调用ModifyUserGroups修改一个或多个用户所属的用户组
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc modify-user-groups --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --user Group=users Name=user11 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserGroups

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en:
The user group to be changed. Valid values:

users: ordinary permissions, which are suitable for ordinary users that need only to submit and debug jobs.
wheel: sudo permissions, which are suitable for administrators who need to manage clusters. In addition to submitting and debugging jobs, you can also run sudo commands to install software and restart nodes
fields.help_zh:
需要修改的用户组。取值范围：

users：普通权限组，适用于只有提交、调试作业需求的普通用户。
wheel：sudo权限组，适用于需要管理集群的管理员，除提交、调试作业外，还可以执行sudo命令进行安装软件、重启节点等操作
fields.name: group

fields.help_en:
The username.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html operation to query the usernames in the cluster
fields.help_zh:
要修改权限的用户名。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html获取该集群中的用户名
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: The users. You can specify 1 to 100 users
parameters.help_zh: 用户信息。可以传入1~100个用户信息
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use asynchronous message links to change the user group.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否采用异步消息链路修改用户组。

默认值：false
parameters.name: async
